retry.qwen_busy_fallback_removed_2026_09_17: qwen_busy_fallback was a dead key with ZERO consumers, and it implied a state ('the local Qwen is busy') that cannot occur: there is no LLM client anywhere on the runtime path (measured 2026-09-17 -- no qwen/llm module exists in winter_agent_v2, and parse_qwen_decision in brain.py is called only by a test). It was removed rather than left as a plausible-looking source of truth that nothing reads, the same call as reserve_marches_for_stamina_spend. The local model is an OPTIONAL offline provider, never a runtime dependency: every rule-based, skill-backed and LIVE_VERIFIED capability runs with no provider at all. tests/test_local_gui_model_decoupling.py pins that, and since 2026-09-30 the provider in question is UI-Venus-2-9B rather than Qwen.

march_policy.reason: Operator policy 2026-09-14: stamina spending beats gathering. Keep slots free for INTEL / beasts and recall the lowest-value gathering march when a stamina sink needs one. Gathering is LAST_RESORT and may only occupy slots with no better use.
march_policy.reserve_is_an_intent_not_a_slot_count: 2026-09-16: this number is the INTENT and is capped by the OBSERVED march capacity, because capacity is role-scoped and grows with progression. Effective reservation = min(reserve_for_stamina, capacity - 2), so it can never claim the whole army. On a capacity-2 role the effective reservation is 0 and realtime work is served by recall-on-demand instead; that role produced three empty GATHER_RESOURCE runs while the value was applied as an absolute 2. See RuleBrain.reserved_slots.

resource_policy.note: Gathering has low value per march-hour compared with stamina sinks. It must never be the reason a stamina task cannot run.
resource_policy.dead_key_removed_2026_09_16: reserve_marches_for_stamina_spend was a second copy of march_policy.reserve_for_stamina with ZERO consumers; it was removed rather than left as a plausible-looking source of truth that nothing reads.

stamina_policy.note: Operator 2026-09-14: the free 丰盛的招待 gift (+150, next supply shown as 下次补给) must be claimed. The paid rows in the same 获取更多 panel (购买并使用 💎300, 超值月卡/礼包购买/英雄集结 前往) are permanently out of scope and are never tapped; only BTN_CLAIM_FREE_STAMINA is a target.

executor.note: Operator directive 2026-09-14: MAA is the default UI-automation backend, ADB is the device layer and fallback. A skill absent from the routing file keeps its historical ADB path, so this file cannot regress a live-verified skill. Turn MAA off entirely by setting maa.enabled=false.

local_planner.note: Operator directive 2026-09-30: the single runtime local model is UI-Venus-2-9B Q4_K_M, replacing the 35.5B MoE Q3 Qwen that was here before. It is a multimodal GUI agent, so the screenshot travels with every call and this section asks for it explicitly (multimodal: true). It names an element id or, when nothing on screen can be named, a semantic target plus an UNTRUSTED normalised region; never a tap coordinate. Set enabled=false and the runtime behaves exactly as it did before this existed. Measured 2026-09-30 against the model it replaced: p50 4.3s per plan versus 17.9s, and 0 timeouts versus 11-in-79. Operator directive the same day raised the window from 8192 to 32768; that is a CEILING and not a target, so the runtime never fills it -- every prompt is fitted by winter_agent_v2/context_budget.py, which reserves output_reserve for the reply and drops in the directive's own P0/P1/P2 order (world_state extras, then older session history, then knowledge, then the element table down to a floor). An ordinary UNKNOWN step runs 6K-16K and a long session 16K-24K; the headroom exists only so a deep session does not die against the wall. Raising context turned out to cost almost no VRAM: UI-Venus-2 is a hybrid linear-attention model, so at n_ctx 32768 llama.cpp reports only 272 MiB of KV on the GPU plus a 23 MiB recurrent state rather than the ~1.5 GB a uniformly-attention model of this size would need. Offload was therefore settled by measurement instead, in tools/profile_device_impact.py and the sweep in tools/profile_gui_model_context.py: full offload (-ngl 33) launches without CUDA OOM but is 2.3x slower than -ngl 30 (39935 ms vs 17041 ms) because 70 MiB of free VRAM makes the driver page, and only -ngl 16 leaves the MAA capture tail untouched. Production runs -ngl 30 / f16 KV: within 3% of the fastest cell while keeping 213-265 MiB free. The reply is also contract-constrained by winter_agent_v2/ui_planner.response_schema, because asking for a short reason in prose was measured not to work.
local_planner.think_note: UI-Venus-2 reasons before it answers, and with the pass left on it spends the whole token budget in reasoning_content and returns an empty content field. GUI planning wants the decision, not the deliberation, so the template is asked to skip it -- which is also the model card's own guidance for grounding tasks. tools/probe_gui_model_multimodal.py measures both settings.

workbuddy_channel.note: Operator directive 2026-09-25 section 1: the automatic WorkBuddy model-call channel is retired from the production chain. WorkBuddy stays a tool a person drives by hand. The code is kept (workbuddy_bridge / unknown_dispatch / gateway_service and their tests) because it is a public component other paths import, and the failure record is kept in knowledge/failure_patterns/integration/WORKBUDDY_CHANNEL_RETIRED.md so the next account does not re-attempt it. Nothing here stops the desktop console or the game runtime: the gateway is still used as a transport for development jobs when a person starts one deliberately.

role_session.note: ROLE SESSION PRODUCTION V2 (operator directive 2026-09-30). One account keeps the device until its own batch is mostly done; another role's merely higher ordinary score is no longer a switching condition. min_role_dwell_seconds and switch_margin are retained but DEMOTED: dwell is a minimum-protection floor (time passing is not a licence to switch) and the margin only decides worth AFTER the session gate has allowed a move. Limited-time work is unaffected -- HARD_EVENT_PREEMPT still outranks all of this.
